title: CM-K230 core stackup and fabrication-process proposal

scope.fixed: Existing edge numbering and mating coordinates must be retained by the separate edge proposal.

decision.preferred_trial: An 8-layer, nominal 1.2 mm, 1 oz finished copper, ENIG, plated-through build with selectively filled/capped vias. Use PCBWay catalog entry 13 as the first mechanical/electrical simulation stack, subject to density and fabrication acceptance.
decision.why: Published 1.2 mm 8-layer construction reduces through-via length and inner dielectric spacing compared with 1.6 mm while preserving four proposed signal layers and three ground layers. The original STEP now corroborates a nominal board-model thickness of 1.538354 mm and overall model height of 2.738258 mm. The 1.2 mm trial deliberately changes that nominal stack height; original fabrication thickness/tolerance and certified assembled height remain unavailable.
decision.fallback: Nominal 1.6 mm through-hole entry 1 remains the closer-to-original-thickness alternative if assembly stiffness, mating/enclosure height, or fab review requires it. Its nominal/published finished thicknesses are still not identical to the original STEP board-model thickness. Escalate to a separately qualified 8-layer HDI stack only if actual BGA escape fails; more ordinary layers alone cannot cure pad/drill clearance failures.
not_established: A single supplier acceptance covering 1 mm castellations and the entire fine-BGA process

published_stackup_candidates.outer_finish: Plated to 1 oz; surface finish selected separately
published_stackup_candidates.thickness_reconciliation: Finished catalog thickness also includes processing/surface layers; do not invent mask thickness by assigning the remaining difference. Published Dk values are catalog inputs, not a frequency-qualified laminate model.
published_stackup_candidates.process_limit: Catalog explicitly applies to through-hole builds, excluding blind and buried vias.

published_stackup_candidates.thickness_reconciliation: Finished catalog thickness also includes processing/surface layers; do not invent mask thickness by assigning the remaining difference. Published Dk values are catalog inputs, not a frequency-qualified laminate model.
published_stackup_candidates.process_limit: Catalog explicitly applies to through-hole builds, excluding blind and buried vias.

copper_density_sensitivity.gate: Compute actual copper coverage per relevant layer, including antipads and hatch/fill; obtain final pressed dielectric schedule before any impedance geometry is released. Do not average the 50% and 70% entries into an invented stock stack.

proposed_layer_roles.role: Components, BGA fanout, short signals, local power

proposed_layer_roles.restriction: No signal routing except separately approved HDI landing-island construction in a new stack.
Rail islands require PDN/current-density design and decoupling.

proposed_layer_roles.reference: L7 GND plus L5 power proximity
proposed_layer_roles.restriction: No high-speed route across L5 splits. Field-solve actual adjacent planes; use for slower nets until return paths are qualified.

proposed_layer_roles.role: Signals, ground stitching and local power; no components
proposed_layer_roles.restriction: Bottom copper is permitted by top-components-only; protect non-castellation copper with solder mask and check carrier clearance.

fabrication_envelope.material: FR-4 stock laminate is not a locked material. Request a temperature/reflow-appropriate named laminate; TG, loss, CTE, moisture and CAF performance remain release inputs.
fabrication_envelope.surface_finish: ENIG proposed for flat fine-BGA and castellation lands
fabrication_envelope.copper: 1 oz finished all layers in the published trial; no 2 oz substitution without redoing trace/space and impedance.

routing_rules.fine_BGA_trial_status: Literal 4/4 mil, premium/DFM-confirmed region. PCBWay basic table rounds 4 mil to 0.1 mm; its detailed table makes 4/4 mil on 35 um inner copper a higher-difficulty case.
routing_rules.three_mil_or_less: Not assigned to the selected 1 oz stack. Advertised 2/2 mil depends on thinner starting copper and local use, and is not a global capability for this build.

via_candidates.purpose: General interconnect away from dense BGA escape
Conditional dogbone or via-in-pad where qualified component land accepts it

fabrication_envelope.via_size_qualification: Hole request is not a claim that the production drill tool equals the final plated bore. Fabricator must resolve drill compensation, nominal-versus-retained annulus, registration and fill/cap geometry. Do not use generic through-hole tolerance to qualify a tiny BGA via.
fabrication_envelope.inner_hole_clearance_selection: Use at least 0.1524 mm only as the advanced-process trial; detailed 8-layer table gives 0.2286 mm normal, 0.1778–0.2286 mm medium, and 0.1524–0.1778 mm high difficulty. All are hole-edge-to-copper requirements, distinct from pad clearance.

through_via_aspect_ratio.interpretation: An analytical thickness/hole screen only; actual drilling and plating acceptance still required.

fabrication_envelope.under_solder_via_treatment: Resin filled, planarized and copper capped (VIPPO) for any through-via within a solderable BGA/component land. Tenting or soldermask plugging alone is not equivalent. Preserve castellated PTHs as open edge contacts, not filled BGA vias.
fabrication_envelope.finish_cap_gate: Specify fill material, cap/flatness acceptance and cross-section/inspection criteria with the assembler/fabricator before release.

castellation_compatibility.calculation: For equal holes centered 1.0 mm apart, nominal web = 1.0 - hole diameter. Pad width, mask bridge, milling and finished bore tolerance impose separate constraints.

candidate_screens.comment: Meets detailed-page nominal minima; smallest hole option needs assembly/mechanical review.
candidate_screens.relation_to_original_STEP_nominal: Smaller than original nominal 0.50 mm model cutout; would be an intentional geometric change

candidate_screens.comment: At nominal standard web minimum; no margin.
candidate_screens.relation_to_original_STEP_nominal: Smaller than original nominal 0.50 mm model cutout; would be an intentional geometric change

candidate_screens.comment: Falls in stated premium web band; plausible edge-proposal candidate.
candidate_screens.relation_to_original_STEP_nominal: Matches nominal cutout diameter only; no drill authority

PCBWay.conflict: PW_CAP advanced row 12 permits >=0.5 mm diameter and >=0.3 mm web; PW_HALF_CONFLICT instead says >=0.6 mm hole and >=0.55 mm spacing, requiring >=1.15 mm pitch. No page is silently treated as universal authorization.

JLCPCB.disposition: Not an unconditional candidate for the fixed 1 mm edge pitch; written exception/clarification would be required.

castellation_compatibility.edge_requirements: Use the separate dimensional edge proposal. Do not infer original module holes from carrier lands; preserve nominal 1 mm pitch and all 140 identities. Bisected plated holes, top/bottom copper and mask, internal antipads, annular anchoring, corner clearances and routed panel support require qualification together.
castellation_compatibility.keepout: The existing 2 mm perimeter reserve remains a planning reservation, not a sourced manufacturing keepout. Replace it only after actual inner pad reach, mask, copper clearance, routing tolerance, component courtyard and panel tab envelope are combined.
castellation_compatibility.original_model_nominal: The original STEP audit now corroborates 140 radius 0.25 mm cutouts at 1 mm nominal pitch, 35 per side. Thus the 0.50 mm candidate matches nominal model cutout diameter. This does not establish actual drill-tool diameter, plating allowance, copper lands, mask or manufacturing tolerance.

conditional_escape_analysis.method: Necessary local geometric bounds; not a router, not proof of global escape, SI, manufacturability or solderability.
conditional_escape_analysis.input_land_policy: All four BGA copper/mask/paste dimensions remain unknown. Package ball diameter, K230 package-context 0.270 mm mask statement and Micron package 0.40 mm SMD pad note are not PCB land specifications.

formulas.center_of_rectangular_cell_dogbone: D_land <= sqrt(px^2 + py^2) - D_via_pad - 2*c; check drill clearance independently
formulas.corridor_between_equal_holes: w <= p - d_hole_or_compensated_drill - 2*c_hole; use the fab-defined hole boundary and actual pad clearance as additional constraints

one_trace_bounds.screen: 3 mil trace with 0.09 mm pad clearance

interpretation: At 0.100/0.100 mm, a 0.65 mm axis allows one trace only if D_land <=0.35 mm; literal 4/4 mil reduces that bound to0.3452 mm. Samsung and Micron LPDDR have an easier0.8 mm X axis but the same0.65 mm Y bottleneck.

For the0.5 mm eMMC grid, the0.100/0.100 bound is0.20 mm (0.1952 mm for literal4/4 mil). This is not permission to shrink its land. The advanced fab minimum BGA diameter0.2032 mm itself exceeds the literal4/4 bound.

A0.35 mm via pad between four populated0.5 mm sites leaves at most0.157107 mm for the surrounding equal BGA lands at0.1 mm copper clearance. Therefore a universal dogbone-every-ball eMMC pattern is not justified.

At0.5 mm via-row pitch,0.15 mm holes and0.1524 mm hole-edge clearance leave only0.0452 mm for a trace;0.20 mm production drill would leave a negative corridor. Filled/capped holes do not remove these internal exclusions.

The eMMC has153 physical balls but only33 previously classified explicit functional/power/ground balls, plus107 NC and13 RFU. Exploit the exact occupied/functional map in an escape study; physical NC/RFU balls still need qualified assembly lands and cannot be erased to make room.

The K230 has390 balls on a20x20 grid, including10 absent sites; A1 is absent. LPDDR physical occupancy has200 balls on12x22 with central row/column gaps. Use existing audited coordinates rather than full rectangular-grid shortcuts.

A successful trial must route every required connection, power and return with actual lands, antipads, neck-down lengths and top-side decouplers. Available layer count alone is not routability evidence.

published_example.rounding_note: Listed individual rounded dimensions sum1 um above the printed total; retain the printed1.506 mm nominal and have the fabricator resolve its production stack.
published_example.via_structure: Figure shows L1–2 andL2–3 staggered laser microvias, mirrored below; a buriedL2–7 hole and full through hole.
published_example.castellation_evidence: Not established for this Würth stack; this is an independently published HDI feasibility reference, not acceptance of140 castellations.

microvia_reference_rules.five_tenths_BGA_reference_variants: The poster offers0.5 mm pitch via-in-pad and dogbone constructions including0.275 mm microvia pads with0.075 mm routing. These are process examples, not land recommendations for Samsung eMMC.

other_published_supplier_envelope.via_fill: Laser copper-filled/planarized; mechanical buried resin-filled/plated cap
other_published_supplier_envelope.note: Do not combine JLC dimensions with the Würth example as one qualified process.

HDI_alternative.escalation_gate: If qualified lands cannot escape in the through-hole trial, request a matched8-layer1+6+1 or2+4+2 drawing/process quote later under separate authorization. L1–2 alone reaches a ground reference layer, so signal landing islands/transfer topology and retained ground continuity must be designed explicitly. Prefer a validated staggered sequence; do not assume stacked microvia reliability.

manufacturer_target_evidence.routing_guidance: Match chip-package plus PCB lengths; equal via counts for same signal type; avoid more than two layer changes.

impedance_and_return_path.release_requirements: Field-solve finished copper, pressed dielectric, actual Dk/loss versus frequency, mask, pad escape neckdowns and adjacent planes. Define per-net targets and test coupons. Check DDR via discontinuities, reference continuity and stitching; audit edge MIPI/USB return paths against the preserved pinout. No50/100-ohm trace width is implied by this proposal.

acceptance_gates.required: Approve exact module outline, 1 mm edge centers and 140-pad identities. Reconcile the original STEP nominal 0.50 mm cutouts, 1.538354 mm board-model thickness and 2.738258 mm overall height with the proposed new fabrication and assembly height ranges; original manufactured tolerances are unavailable. Validate half-hole copper/mask/plating geometry and tolerance separately.

One selected fabricator must accept the entire combined stack, dense-via, VIPPO,1 mm castellation and panelization process in writing; resolve contradictory public guidance. No vendor contact performed.
Qualify exact K230, Samsung LPDDR/eMMC and optional Micron PCB lands, solder mask, paste and assembly construction. Manufacturer ball dimensions alone do not close this.

Resolve CAD hole convention versus finished bore/tool diameter, retained annulus, drill registration, copper clearances and fill/cap inspection. Use actual compensated drill in geometric escape checks.

Route an isolated real-land escape trial using the audited ball occupancy and functional map; all required balls, six rails, returns and top-side decouplers must connect without waivers hidden by a body-fit study.
Select copper-density-specific pressed stack and named laminate; obtain impedance calculations/coupon acceptance for required interfaces, including short escape neckdowns.
Verify ground/rail connectivity, via current, IR drop, PDN and thermal performance within the core-only scope. No external heatsink is assumed.
Finish top-side assembly placement, stencil/reflow/BGA X-ray strategy and board warpage/height check; qualify all bottom-side copper against the carrier.
Verify castellation milling, open-hole plating, panel support tab/fiducial/tooling geometry and final Gerber/drill/CAM review. No V-score may cut through plated edge contacts.
Only after all above gates may the chosen process be promoted to master CAD and fabrication release. Micron remains a separate electrical/firmware/ordering substitution decision.
